name: GrassPad: Idiot-Proof + Seed Safe + Fall Renovation
about: **Programs merged:** Idiot-Proof (5-Step) · Seed Safe (spring seeding) · Fall Renovation / Overseeding, plus optional supplemental tasks (grubs, mosquitoes, watering, mowing, disease).

name: Cool-season lawn (fescue, bluegrass, ryegrass): 5-step program
about: **Program:** a brand-neutral 5-step plan for **tall fescue, Kentucky bluegrass and perennial ryegrass** (the northern US and the transition zone), plus optional supplemental tasks.

name: Warm-season lawn (Bermuda, Zoysia, St. Augustine, Centipede): 5-step program
about: **Program:** a brand-neutral plan for **Bermuda, Zoysia, St. Augustine, Centipede and Bahia** (the South, Southwest and transition zone). Steps note species differences.
